model: RandomForestClassifier (300 trees, random_state=42) with median imputation of zero-valued measurements
notes: Stratified 80/20 split. followup_score was excluded because it is a post-diagnosis-looking measure that almost perfectly separates the outcome (r=0.83), which would be leakage. Its original values were accidentally deleted from data.csv and holdout_features.csv and could not be restored.
